# Community Pages

> Free, volunteer-run website listing community activities and events across Greater Manchester that are free, donation-based or cost £5 or less. Covers all ten boroughs: Manchester, Salford, Trafford, Stockport, Tameside, Oldham, Rochdale, Bury, Bolton and Wigan. Built for residents and for social prescribing link workers.

Typical activities: coffee mornings, chatty cafés, ESOL and English classes, job clubs, digital help, walking groups, chair exercise, stay and play, baby and toddler groups, lunch clubs, food banks, wellbeing and peer support groups, choirs, craft and knitting groups, gardening.

- 1218 current listings, checked by hand and updated every day.
- Each listing gives the date or how often it runs, start and end time, venue with postcode, area, cost (free, donation, £5 or less, or price not stated) and whether it is one-off or regular.
- Activities costing more than £5, political campaigns, religious worship and business promotion are not listed.
- People should check with the organiser before going.

## Pages

- [Find activities](https://communitypages.org.uk/): searchable list by date, area and postcode, with a printable list.
- [All listings as plain text](https://communitypages.org.uk/llms-full.txt): every current activity, one per line, grouped by area.
- [About](https://communitypages.org.uk/about/): who runs the site and what is listed.
- [For link workers](https://communitypages.org.uk/link-workers/): how to find and print local activities for someone.
- [How to print a list](https://communitypages.org.uk/print/): step-by-step guide to printing activities for people who aren't online or for a noticeboard.
- [Add an event](https://communitypages.org.uk/add/): how anyone can add a local activity for free.
- Pages by borough: [Manchester](https://communitypages.org.uk/area/manchester/), [Salford](https://communitypages.org.uk/area/salford/), [Trafford](https://communitypages.org.uk/area/trafford/), [Stockport](https://communitypages.org.uk/area/stockport/), [Tameside](https://communitypages.org.uk/area/tameside/), [Oldham](https://communitypages.org.uk/area/oldham/), [Rochdale](https://communitypages.org.uk/area/rochdale/), [Bury](https://communitypages.org.uk/area/bury/), [Bolton](https://communitypages.org.uk/area/bolton/), [Wigan](https://communitypages.org.uk/area/wigan/)
- Pages by type of activity: [Coffee mornings and chatty cafés](https://communitypages.org.uk/activity/coffee-chat/), [Wellbeing and support groups](https://communitypages.org.uk/activity/wellbeing-support/), [Family, baby and toddler activities](https://communitypages.org.uk/activity/family-kids/), [ESOL, job clubs and learning](https://communitypages.org.uk/activity/learning-skills/), [Exercise, walks and sport](https://communitypages.org.uk/activity/active-sport/), [Gardening and nature](https://communitypages.org.uk/activity/outdoors-nature/), [Arts, crafts and writing groups](https://communitypages.org.uk/activity/arts-crafts/), [Choirs, singing and music](https://communitypages.org.uk/activity/music-singing/), [Lunch clubs, community meals and food](https://communitypages.org.uk/activity/food-markets/), [Free films and talks](https://communitypages.org.uk/activity/film-talks/), [Community groups and events](https://communitypages.org.uk/activity/community/)
